# AgentReady Woo

> AgentReady scans self-hosted WooCommerce stores and scores how ready they are for AI-agent commerce (MCP/A2A), then generates a live product feed that shopping agents can query and sell from. Checkout completes on the merchant's own site via signed cart handoff — no card data ever passes through AgentReady.

A free scan grades any WooCommerce store's agent-readiness out of 100: discovery files, Store API health, feed quality, cart-handoff support. Merchants fix the reported gaps, then expose their catalog to shopping agents including ChatGPT shopping surfaces, Claude, and independent agents. Product feeds re-sync from the store every 15 minutes — price and stock stay live.

## Pricing

- **Free** — forever: readiness score, top-10 product feed
- **Deep Report** — $9 one-off: full gap report, competitor comparison, shareable badge
- **Pro** — $99 once: unlimited offers, signed cart handoff, weekly agent-activity email — no renewal
- **Agency** — $199/year: 25 client stores, priority support

## For agents and developers

- MCP endpoint: `https://app.utilityhouse.xyz/mcp/{store_id}` (Model Context Protocol) — `POST {"tool": "...", "input": {...}}`
- Per-store agent discovery file + JSON product feed (price, stock, categories, sale prices)
- Cart handoff: HMAC-signed, single-use links expiring in ≤60 minutes; buyer completes checkout on the merchant's own site
- Auth: merchant-issued read-only WooCommerce REST API key, revocable in one click
- Setup: paste store URL + a read-only WooCommerce REST API key — no plugin install required, five minutes
